title: Best Instant Proximity Prompt Script
features: You won't need to hold any proximity prompt for now!!
script:
--[[
    Proximity Prompt Hold Duration Remover
    Sets all ProximityPrompt HoldDuration to 0
]]

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

-- Function to hook a ProximityPrompt
local function hookPrompt(v)
    if v:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
        v.HoldDuration = 0
        -- If the game tries to change HoldDuration back, reset it to 0
        v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("HoldDuration"):Connect(function()
            if v.HoldDuration ~= 0 then
                v.HoldDuration = 0
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- Handle existing ProximityPrompts
for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    hookPrompt(v)
end

-- Handle ProximityPrompts added in the future
Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
    hookPrompt(v)
end)
